args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy, with an error rate of ~18%. SRE rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent version known healthy in production, across all production regions. Rollback confirmed complete: all regions now serving v2.3.0 and rolled out. Follow-up needed: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the gap in the deployment validation/health-check gate.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Verified the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified the target version**: The release history showed v2.3.1 as unhealthy, with **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Rolled back**: checkout-api is now serving v2.3.0 in all production regions; the rollback was confirmed as fully rolled out.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure, the rollback, and recommended follow-up (investigate root cause of v2.3.1 and review deployment validation gates). The on-call engineer has been paged.
